create_crowd_sourced_annotation_model: create a CrowdSourcedAnnotation model with n items, k labelers, and num_categories for probabilistic label inference
build_confusion_matrix_distribution: build a Dirichlet confusion matrix distribution for each labeler and category using expected correctness priors
convert_data_to_observations: convert an xarray Dataset of crowd labels into a dictionary mapping random variables to observations for Bean Machine
extract_inference_samples: extract MonteCarloSamples from Bean Machine into an xarray Dataset with prevalence and confusion matrix dimensions
get_inference_queries: get a list of random variable queries including prevalence and confusion matrix for all labelers and categories
